description: Find Adobe Quality Patches Tool (QPT) patches for a Magento Open Source or Adobe Commerce version. With only distribution and version it lists every applicable patch. Add query (symptoms, error text, feature words or a patch id like ACSD-56760), modules (e.g. "catalog", "module-sales") or categories (QPT names like "Admin", "Catalog/Product") to get a ranked list with a 0-100 relevance score and the signals that matched. Covers quality patches only; for security fixes use check_version_security. List mode can return several hundred hits; pass query, modules or categories to rank and limit. Mage-OS is not a QPT target and always returns status "unknown".

includeInapplicable.description: Also rank patches that do not apply to this version; each hit keeps its real applicable flag

modules.description: Module names with or without the magento/module- prefix

query.description: Free text: symptoms, error message, feature names, or a patch id

name: find_patch
